whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hungry Sardar,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.3★ reviews with over 400 happy diners in Patna, but your online presence currently relies only on third-party aggregator directories instead of a dedicated brand website.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservations, digital menu, aur WhatsApp food orders integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hungrysardar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Hungry Sardar team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a direct digital menu, table booking, and mobile-first speed for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
